description: Hand-curated expectations for the bundled Q3 planning meeting. Used by metrics.py and the LLM-as-judge evaluator. Values here are not exact outputs but constraints the synthesis must satisfy.

required_topics.rationale: Theme 1 of the meeting was about OTA update failures during peak deployment windows. This must be picked up.
Theme 2 was about navigation search surfacing unavailable EV charging stations.
Theme 3 was about warranty claim status confusion across intake channels.
Theme 4 was about connected-services subscription tier confusion.

forbidden_topics.rationale: Explicitly declined in the meeting (`Things we explicitly said NO to`) — owned by OEM HW.

expected_duplicates.rationale: AD-412 is the in-progress 'Available Now' EV-charger availability badge fix — clearly the same problem space.
AD-389 is the connected-services trial expiry notification — same theme.

expected_constraint_conflicts.rationale: Automatic rollback of safety-critical ECU updates is FORBIDDEN without a validated rollback image under ISO 26262 (Section 3). Any story proposing this should be flagged.
